SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the title of patent US-5153197-A?
SELECT patent_number, title, publication_date FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE patent_number = 'US-5153197-A'
Which counties are split among the most ZIP code areas?
SELECT namelsad_county_20, geoid_county_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audits raise doubt about the organisation continuing as a going concern?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_going_concern_included AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wholesale power contracts did Lakeside Syracuse LLC report?
SELECT count(DISTINCT contract_unique_id) AS contracts FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE seller_company_name = 'Lakeside Syracuse LLC'
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many certification marks are on file with the trademark office?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(cert_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which Oklahoma counties host the most turbines?
SELECT t_county, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'OK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds weigh more than 1,000 daltons?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE try_cast(c2 AS double) > 1000
Which industries had the most women-owned small business set-asides posted on SAM.gov?
SELECT naicscode, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE setaside LIKE '%Women%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the clinical toxicity set are approved drugs?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_clintox WHERE fda_approved = 1
Which kinds of cross-reference does ChEBI record most often?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_database_accession WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many colleges are in Montgomery, Alabama?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unitid) AS institutions FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE city = 'MONTGOMERY' AND stabbr = 'AL'
What share of mortgage applications were denied for each race of applicant in 2023?

SELECT derived_race, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water system lead results came in above the 0.015 mg/L action level?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_lcr_samples WHERE contaminant_code = 'PB90' AND try_cast(sample_measure AS double) > 0.015
Which states had the most traffic deaths in 2021?
SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many medicinal-chemistry-like molecules does GDBMedChem list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdbmedchem
Which kinds of measurement are most common among ChEMBL bioactivity results?
SELECT standard_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE standard_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Gene Ontology terms are mapped to Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2go
Which conditions have the most approved treatments?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions found in granted patents change from 1980 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('1980', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which companies sponsor the most connected political action committees?
SELECT connected_org_nm, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE connected_org_nm <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
Which states received the most federal grant and loan dollars in fiscal year 2022?

SELECT recipient_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
